root_idea.summary: The root centers on not reaching an object's full extent and on holding or confining something within bounds.
root_idea.development: These two closely related principles develop into shortness, falling short, curtailment, restriction, and enclosure. The same orientation also underlies reserved persons or things, enclosed spaces, and several conventional temporal and anatomical terms.

senses.definition: To shorten or curtail the prayer.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction قَصَرَ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ, shortening means performing the normally four-unit prayer as two units during travel, by omitting part of it under the stated dispensation.

senses.definition: To desist or cease from pursuing or doing something.
senses.usage_conditions: With عَنْهُ, the Quranic use denotes stopping or desisting from something that one could otherwise pursue or do; the construction can contrast with cessation through inability.

senses.definition: One who shortens or clips hair.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic participle describes those who shorten part of the hair in the pilgrimage context, as opposed to those who shave the head.

senses.definition: Confined, kept within, or reserved in a pavilion.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description, the feminine plural denotes women kept within the tents or pavilions; the restriction may also be understood as being reserved for their husbands or as having their gaze restricted to them.

senses.definition: A palace, mansion, castle, or fortified building.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural قُصُورٌ and related singular uses refer to substantial buildings or palaces, including a castle or fortress.
This is an explicitly reported interpretation of the قَصْرِ expression in 77:32, distinct from the building sense.

senses.definition: Thick bases of necks, or the trunks and lower parts of trees.
senses.usage_conditions: This is another reported interpretation of the expression in 77:32, associated with the vocalized form قَصَرٌ; the tree sense refers especially to substantial trunks or their remains.

senses.definition: Restraining the gaze and looking only toward one's husband.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic feminine plural is a conventional description of women whose eyes are restrained from what is not permitted and are not directed toward anyone besides their husbands.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become short; to have little height or extent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic intransitive physical sense, opposite of being long or tall.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fall short of reaching, attaining, or accomplishing something; to lack the power to achieve it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ or دُونَ and with affairs, places, hopes, or required actions; it can also describe remissness or failure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain, desist, or cease from something; for pain, anger, or rain, to leave off or cease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With عَنْهُ, cessation may be voluntary or may result from inability; the sources distinguish this use from desisting while still able, though the two may overlap.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter the afternoon or evening, or to approach the last part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb is used of entering the time called العَشِيّ or the period shortly before nightfall.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something short, contracted, concise, or scant; to remove part of its length.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applies to such things as hair, speech, a gift, a tether or shackle, and other objects whose extent can be reduced. The prayer-specific use is represented separately above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confine, restrict, limit, withhold, or keep someone or something within bounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may restrict a person to an action, place, possession, or object, or restrain the eyes, desire, movement, or another activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To beat, wash, and whiten cloth or garments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized craft use of the transitive verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a gift scanty or mean; to be deficient in liberality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of failing to provide what is due or of giving less than the recipient might properly expect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to give birth to short children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical Arabic Form IV use, distinct from the Quranic use of desisting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feign shortness or to contract and draw oneself together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb can describe a person who presents himself as short or who physically contracts himself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become abject, mean, contemptible, or despicable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use referring to the person's spirit or self becoming diminished in status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of shade, to become contracted or shortened.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or natural-process use applied specifically to the extent of shade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confine oneself to something, not exceed it, and be satisfied or content with it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With عَلَى or بِ, the verb may denote limiting oneself to a matter, accepting less, or complying with a command.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reckon someone or something short, deficient, or below what should be done.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may mean judging a person to have fallen short of an obligation or to have been remiss.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become contracted, with one part drawn into another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized form describing a person who becomes physically compressed or drawn together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Falling short, remissness, laziness, or slothfulness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes failure to reach or perform what was required, including lack of diligence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The utmost limit, extent, or end of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the construction قَصْرُكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ كَذَا, it denotes the limit of one's power, action, or available course.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A close paternal cousin or other nearly related relative.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can be applied to a cousin through the paternal uncle, paternal aunt, maternal uncle, or maternal aunt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lowest or flank-adjacent rib.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The precise rib varies among authorities, but it is located toward the lower side between the flank and belly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The clipping or shortening of hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun referring to cutting the hair short rather than shaving it completely.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Short or low; by extension, limited in power, ambition, knowledge, or lineage, and concise in speech or narrative.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative extensions describe restricted capacity or extent; they do not impose a restriction on the physical class of the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shortened, contracted, or confined.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This adjectival use covers things made shorter or kept within limits and is distinct from the basic adjective meaning short in stature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, kept close to the dwelling and treated as precious rather than left to pasture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized conventional description of a valuable horse kept near its owners.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman kept within the house or tent, behind a curtain, or otherwise not permitted to go out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This Classical Arabic use concerns physical seclusion; the Quranic passive-participle form has its own entry above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal retained for a household or particular owner, whose produce is reserved for them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used of a she-camel whose milk is kept for the household or for a designated animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The craft of beating, washing, and whitening clothes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A professional or technical noun for the cloth-processing trade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who beats, washes, and whitens clothes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The occupational noun names the practitioner of the cloth-processing craft.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who restrains the eyes from looking at what is not permitted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine construction قَاصِرَةُ الطَّرْفِ is especially used of a woman whose gaze is directed only toward her husband; its Quranic plural is represented above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of shade, contracting or becoming shorter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of shade whose extent has diminished.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woven receptacle for dates or dried dates.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In conventional usage the name applies while the receptacle contains dates; otherwise it may be called a basket or sack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman or wife, in a figurative use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This figurative meaning is reported as an extension of the container term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Shorter or shortest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The comparative adjective has the feminine قُصْرَى and plural أَقَاصِرُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A necklace or collar that lies closely around the base of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term denotes a necklace resembling a tight neck-band and is named for its close position at the neck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be content with less than one was seeking or with an inferior thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in constructions such as رَضِيَ بِمَقْصَرٍ مِنَ الأَمْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An enclosed or private compartment, apartment, or section of a larger building or area.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can denote a walled mansion or chamber, a private section of a house, the imam's enclosure in a mosque, a curtained bridal canopy, or privately reserved ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden implement used by a cloth-beater to beat garments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may also refer to a suitable piece of wood, especially one made from the jujube tree.

Illustrative proverb and extension of the shortness sense.

cautions: The interpretation of 77:32 has been kept separate from the building sense: Lane reports firewood under قَصْرٌ and also records an interpretation associated with قَصَرٌ, thick neck-bases or tree trunks. The supplied QAC location securely identifies the Quran word, but the alternative lexical interpretations should not be treated as an unqualified modern translation.
The public headwords normalize inflected QAC forms to Classical Arabic citation forms, including قَصَرَ, أَقْصَرَ, مُقَصِّرٌ, مَقْصُورَةٌ, and قَاصِرَةٌ.
